recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: teams wiring the MCP cloud between agents and tools
screens learning colors beyond the old RGB triangle
a miniature Kotlin dialect taking shape in the margins
overcast summer fog sitting low over San Francisco at 13°C
stutter-house pulses drifting through grey July mornings
Orinoco-flow calm cutting through trip-hop summer playlists

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter-house beats on a fogged phone screen—each hit clears a patch of grey mist to reveal hidden color primaries beneath.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nail a 16-beat streak and the screen blooms into a multi-primary color wash
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM stutters faster while fog regrows between missed beats
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: grey monochrome dissolving into oversaturated RYB primaries

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw one continuous wire between MCP server nodes before the cloud times out—each clean connection drops a tiny Kotlin token into your compile pile.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: chain five routes without crossing and watch a micro-language compile in real time
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: nodes multiply, timer shrinks, dead-end branches flicker in and out
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon terminal wireframe on dark navy

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick agent shortcuts off a foggy cliffside into iOS action tiles—land the right combo to spin up a build before sunrise.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: stick a triple-combo landing in under 45 seconds
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: wind shear increases and tiles shuffle mid-flight
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout San Francisco skyline at dawn

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort drifting music genres into summer lanes—swedish pop left, reggae right, dream pop center—as yacht-rock currents pull you off course.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: survive one minute without a genre collision
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: lanes narrow, cross-currents appear, surprise genres drop from above
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor album sleeves sliding on frosted glass
